description: Severity guidance rules — CVSS-to-severity mapping and alignment checks. Sourced from review_taxonomy.yaml (SEV, CVSS) and config.py (CVSS_RANGES).

entries.title: CVSS 9.0-10.0 maps to Critical severity
entries.description: A CVSS score between 9.0 and 10.0 inclusive corresponds to Critical severity. If the reported severity differs, flag as CVSS-severity mismatch.
entries.action: Expected severity is 'critical'. If reported severity differs, flag mismatch (taxonomy SEV). Do NOT auto-correct.

entries.title: CVSS 7.0-8.9 maps to High severity
entries.description: A CVSS score between 7.0 and 8.9 inclusive corresponds to High severity. If the reported severity differs, flag as CVSS-severity mismatch.
entries.action: Expected severity is 'high'. If reported severity differs, flag mismatch (taxonomy SEV). Do NOT auto-correct.

entries.title: CVSS 4.0-6.9 maps to Medium severity
entries.description: A CVSS score between 4.0 and 6.9 inclusive corresponds to Medium severity. If the reported severity differs, flag as CVSS-severity mismatch.
entries.action: Expected severity is 'medium'. If reported severity differs, flag mismatch (taxonomy SEV). Do NOT auto-correct.

entries.title: CVSS 0.1-3.9 maps to Low severity
entries.description: A CVSS score between 0.1 and 3.9 inclusive corresponds to Low severity. If the reported severity differs, flag as CVSS-severity mismatch.
entries.action: Expected severity is 'low'. If reported severity differs, flag mismatch (taxonomy SEV). Do NOT auto-correct.

entries.title: CVSS 0.0 maps to Informational severity
entries.description: A CVSS score of exactly 0.0 corresponds to Informational severity. This indicates no direct security impact.
entries.action: Expected severity is 'informational'. If reported severity differs, flag mismatch (taxonomy SEV).

entries.title: Severity escalation without evidence is a warning
entries.description: If a finding reports High or Critical severity but the evidence does not support the impact claim, the severity may be inflated. Flag for human review rather than auto-downgrading.
conditions: severity in [critical, high] AND evidence does not support impact
entries.action: Flag as severity-evidence mismatch. Escalate to human reviewer. Do NOT auto-downgrade severity.

entries.title: Impact description must align with severity level
entries.description: The impact description should reflect the severity level. A Critical finding should describe significant business impact (data breach, system compromise). A Low finding should describe minimal impact.
conditions: impact description does not align with reported severity
entries.action: Flag as impact-severity misalignment. Report both values for human decision.
